entries.head: figure out

senses.en: to understand something after thinking about it

example.en: I can't figure out why the app keeps logging me out.
example.zh: 我搞不懂这 App 为什么老把我退出登录。

entries.l1_note: “想明白”不是 think out（很少这么用）；figure out 才是日常说法。

entries.head: look up

senses.en: to find information in a dictionary or online

example.en: Look up the word if you don't know it.
example.zh: 不认识的词就查一下。

entries.l1_note: “查词典”不是 look dictionary；必须先说词，再说 look it up。

entries.head: set up

senses.en: to arrange a meeting or call

example.en: Can you set up a call with the design team?
example.zh: 你能跟设计团队约个电话会吗？

senses.en: to prepare equipment or an account for use

example.en: IT set up my laptop before I started.
example.zh: 我入职前 IT 已经把电脑配置好了。

entries.l1_note: “约会议”不是 set a meeting（也能说）更常见是 set up a meeting；setup 名词是一个词。

entries.head: back up

senses.en: to support someone or their claim

example.en: Could you back me up in the meeting tomorrow?
example.zh: 明天开会你能帮我说话吗？

senses.en: to make a copy of computer data

example.en: Back up the files before you update the system.
example.zh: 更新系统前先备份文件。

entries.l1_note: “支持某人”不是 support with words 才行；back someone up 更口语。代词夹中间。

entries.head: log in

senses.en: to enter your account on a device or site

example.en: I can't log in — the password reset email never arrived.
example.zh: 我登不进去，重置密码的邮件一直没来。

entries.l1_note: 登录是 log in / log on；不是 enter the account（中式）。

entries.head: log out

senses.en: to end your session on a device or site

example.en: Log out before you use the shared computer.
example.zh: 用公用电脑前先退出登录。

entries.l1_note: 退出是 log out，不是 close the account（那是注销账号）。
collocations: log out on a shared device

entries.head: sign in

senses.en: to enter your details to use a service

example.en: Sign in with your phone number and you're done.
example.zh: 用手机号登录就完成了。

entries.l1_note: sign in 和 log in 基本同义；sign up 是注册。

entries.head: shut down

senses.en: to turn off a computer or system completely

example.en: Shut down the laptop before you pack it.
example.zh: 装包前把电脑关机。

entries.l1_note: 关机是 shut down；sleep 是睡眠，别混。

entries.head: boot up

senses.en: when a computer starts and is ready

example.en: It takes five minutes to boot up with all those updates.
example.zh: 装了那些更新，开机要五分钟。

entries.l1_note: 开机启动是 boot up / start up；不是 open the computer（中式）。

entries.head: start up

senses.en: to make a program or machine begin running

example.en: Start up the app and scan the code at the door.
example.zh: 打开 App，在门口扫码。

entries.l1_note: start up 是启动；startup 名词是“初创公司”。

entries.head: hook up

senses.en: to connect devices or equipment

example.en: Hook up the monitor to the dock and it should work.
example.zh: 把显示器接到扩展坞上应该就行了。

entries.l1_note: hook up 是接线连接；hook up with 也有“约见、搭上”的意思。

entries.head: plug in

senses.en: to connect a device to electricity

example.en: Plug in your laptop — you're at 3 percent.
example.zh: 把电脑插上电，你只剩 3% 了。

entries.l1_note: 插电是 plug in；充电是 charge。

entries.head: charge up

senses.en: to put electricity into a battery

example.en: Charge up the power bank before the trip.
example.zh: 出门前把充电宝充满。

entries.l1_note: 充电是 charge (up)，不是 add electricity（中式）。

entries.head: die on

senses.en: when a device stops working when you need it

example.en: My phone died on me right when I needed the QR code.
example.zh: 正要扫码的时候手机突然没电了。

entries.l1_note: “没电了”是 the battery died / my phone died on me，不是 no electricity。

entries.head: freeze up

senses.en: when a device or program stops responding

example.en: The screen froze up during the video call.
example.zh: 视频会议时屏幕卡死了。

entries.l1_note: 卡死是 freeze up / freeze；不是 stop the computer（中式）。

entries.head: sync up

senses.en: to make data the same on two devices

example.en: Sync up your notes before you switch phones.
example.zh: 换手机前先把笔记同步一下。

entries.l1_note: 同步是 sync (up)，不是 sync together（重复）。

entries.head: pop up

senses.en: when a window or message appears suddenly

example.en: A login prompt popped up every time I opened the page.
example.zh: 每次打开页面都弹出登录框。

entries.l1_note: 弹窗是 pop up；名词是 pop-up。

entries.head: scroll through

senses.en: to move through content on a screen

example.en: I scrolled through the comments and gave up after ten.
example.zh: 我翻了翻评论，看了十条就不想看了。

entries.l1_note: 刷手机是 scroll through，不是 brush the phone（中式直译）。

entries.head: tap on

senses.en: to touch an icon or link on a screen

example.en: Tap on the avatar to change your photo.
example.zh: 点头像就能换照片。

entries.l1_note: 点开是 tap on / click on；不是 press the icon（偏生硬）。

entries.head: click through

senses.en: to open links one by one

example.en: I clicked through every result and found nothing useful.
example.zh: 我把每条结果都点进去看了，没有有用的。

entries.l1_note: click through 是逐个点开；click 一下是 click on。

entries.head: opt out

senses.en: to choose not to take part in something

example.en: You can opt out of the newsletter at the bottom of every email.
example.zh: 每封邮件底部都能退订。

entries.l1_note: 退出订阅是 opt out (of)，不是 cancel out（那是抵消）。

entries.head: opt in

senses.en: to choose to take part in something

example.en: You have to opt in to get the discount.
example.zh: 得手动勾选才能拿到折扣。

entries.l1_note: opt in 是主动加入；opt out 是退出，成对记。

entries.head: filter out

senses.en: to remove things you do not want

example.en: Filter out the ads and the list is actually short.
example.zh: 把广告过滤掉，名单其实很短。

entries.l1_note: 过滤掉是 filter out；filter 单独是筛选。

entries.head: turn on

senses.en: to make a device start working

example.en: Turn on the hotspot — the WiFi here is terrible.
example.zh: 开一下热点，这里的 WiFi 太差了。

entries.l1_note: 开灯、开电器用 turn on，不是 open the light（最典型的中式英语）。

entries.head: turn off

senses.en: to make a device stop working

example.en: Turn off notifications when you're studying.
example.zh: 学习时把通知关掉。

entries.l1_note: 关灯、关电器是 turn off，不是 close the light。

entries.head: pair up

senses.en: to connect two devices wirelessly

example.en: Hold the button until the earbuds pair up with your phone.
example.zh: 按住按钮直到耳机和手机配对。

entries.l1_note: 蓝牙配对是 pair up / pair；connect 也行但 less specific。

entries.head: link up

senses.en: to connect two accounts or devices

example.en: Link up your bank card before you check out.
example.zh: 结账前先把银行卡绑上。

entries.l1_note: 关联账户是 link up；link 单独也常用。

entries.head: drop out

senses.en: when a connection suddenly stops

example.en: The call dropped out twice during my interview.
example.zh: 面试时通话掉线了两次。

entries.l1_note: 掉线是 drop out / drop；退学也是 drop out，看语境。

entries.head: time out

senses.en: when a system stops waiting and fails

example.en: The page timed out, so I had to fill the form again.
example.zh: 页面超时了，我只好重新填表。

entries.l1_note: 超时是 time out；名词是 time-out（暂停）。

entries.head: wipe out

senses.en: to delete all data from a device

example.en: He wiped out his phone before selling it.
example.zh: 卖手机前他把数据全清了。

entries.l1_note: wipe out 也指“累垮、撞翻”，数码语境是清空。
